Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q1 2021 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of GS.
Our gross margin expanded by 90 basis points to 69.3%, reflecting improved operational efficiency.
We believe the pipeline is strong, but conversion timing remains uncertain given customer budget cycles.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q1 2021.
Our gross margin expanded by 90 basis points to 69.3%, reflecting improved operational efficiency.
We expect revenues to grow approximately 14% to 30% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
Could you quantify the FX headwind embedded in your guidance?
Thank you for the question. Operating income reached $4.6 billion, demonstrating the operating leverage in our model.
Second question - Analyst:
Are you seeing any signs of demand elasticity in your enterprise segment?
Our outlook assumes current foreign exchange rates hold; currency fluctuations could materially affect results.
